Daily Devotional

February 19

5 For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence. (Acts 1:5 KJV)

This is where Jesus, after His resurrection, was telling His apostles to go to Jerusalem and await the coming baptism of the Holy Ghost and fire (Matthew 3:11 & Luke 3:16), that He would send to them after His ascension into heaven. The baptism by water is not essential for salvation, but was a commandment of Jesus (Mark 16:16), and shows submission to Him, and should be done by all that are born again if possible, as we must obey Jesus to assure our salvation (Hebrews 5:9).

The power of the Holy Ghost is something that all Christians should want, as it is the power of God in our lives, and gives us the Spiritual Gifts including speaking in tongues (Ephesians 4:8). You don’t have to speak in tongues to be saved, but it is a powerful gift of the Spirit. If you were water baptized as Jesus commanded (Matthew 28:19), you have the Holy Ghost. If not you should pray for the baptism of the Holy Ghost, so that you might enjoy the power of God in this life, now. You do not have to wait, as the apostles did, but can pray for the baptism of the Holy Ghost any time after you have been born again. But it is a separate spiritual baptism, and must be prayed for after your salvation, if it was not received at your water baptism.

Shortly after this verse, Jesus was taken up into heaven (Acts 1:9-10), and we know that He made it back to God the Father, as He did send the Holy Ghost to His apostles (Acts 2:1-4). We need to thank God every day for the sacrifice of Jesus, as well as the sending of the Holy Ghost, to give all the born again children of God, the power to live the Christian life. Thank you Lord for all our gifts of the Spirit.
